title: On the Problem of Underranking in Group-Fair Ranking
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and mathematical aspects of algorithmic fairness in ranking systems, specifically proposing a new metric called 'underranking' to study the worst-case effects on individuals in group-fair re-ranking. While it addresses ethical concerns as a motivation for the work, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as subject matter; instead, it provides an algorithmic solution for mathematical fairness constraints.
